description: Generate clean lab fishbone diagrams (lab value skeletons), the shorthand nurses, residents and students use in notes and case presentations: BMP / Chem-7 (Na | Cl | BUN over K | HCO3 | Cr with glucose in the tail), CBC (WBC > Hgb over Hct < Plt), coags (PT | PTT over INR), LFT (TP | AST | T bili over Alb | ALT | ALP), ABG (pH / pCO2 / pO2 / HCO3) and Ca/Mg/Phos, each with an optional caption such as a time, in a tidy grid. Numeric values outside adult reference ranges are flagged red with ↑ or blue with ↓ (US or SI ranges; overridable per value), and the result also includes a plain-text version to paste into a note. Choose it whenever lab results should be shown in fishbone form; it is not a cause-and-effect (Ishikawa) diagram, for which use create_fishbone. Values are strings of up to 8 characters; 1–8 panels. A drawing aid only, not clinical decision support: never include patient names or identifiers, because links carry the data. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

inputSchema.description: Lab value skeletons ("fishbone" diagrams): the clinical shorthand for a BMP, CBC, coags, LFT, ABG and Ca/Mg/Phos, with abnormal values flagged. A drawing aid, not clinical decision support.

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

flag.description: Flag numeric values outside the adult reference range: red with ↑ when high, blue with ↓ when low. Default true. Manual `flags` on a panel apply either way. Ranges vary by lab; this is a drawing aid, not clinical decision support.

labels.description: Show a small analyte name (Na, K, Hgb…) beside every value. Default false: experienced readers know the positions; turn it on for teaching or for readers new to the shorthand.

palette.description: Hex colours; only the first is used, for the small panel-type tags. The skeletons stay monochrome, and flags are always red (high) and blue (low).

panels.description: The panels to draw (1–8), in order, two or three per row. Each has a `type` and its values as flat string keys; leave a key out to leave its position blank. More than 8 are dropped.

alb.description: Albumin (Alb), LFT: bottom left. g/dL (US) or g/L (SI), e.g. "3.9". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

alp.description: Alkaline phosphatase (ALP), LFT: bottom right. U/L, e.g. "88". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

alt.description: ALT, LFT: bottom middle. U/L, e.g. "28". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

ast.description: AST, LFT: top middle. U/L, e.g. "32". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

bun.description: Blood urea nitrogen (BUN), BMP: top right. mg/dL (US) or urea mmol/L (SI), e.g. "18". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

ca.description: Calcium (Ca), Ca/Mg/Phos: above the line. mg/dL (US) or mmol/L (SI), e.g. "9.2". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

caption.description: Optional short caption above the panel, after its type tag, e.g. "06:00" or "Day 3, post-op". Never a patient name or identifier.

cl.description: Chloride (Cl), BMP: top middle. mmol/L, e.g. "102". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

cr.description: Creatinine (Cr), BMP: bottom right. mg/dL (US) or µmol/L (SI), e.g. "1.1". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

flags.description: Optional manual flags that override the automatic ones for single values: { "k": "high" } draws K in red with ↑, "low" in blue with ↓, "normal" removes an automatic flag. Keys are the value keys above.

glu.description: Glucose (Glu), BMP: in the tail on the right. mg/dL (US) or mmol/L (SI), e.g. "112". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

hco3.description: Bicarbonate (HCO3): BMP bottom middle (serum CO2, mmol/L, e.g. "24"), or the last value of an ABG. A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

hct.description: Hematocrit (Hct), CBC: bottom middle. % (US) or L/L (SI), e.g. "39.5". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

hgb.description: Hemoglobin (Hgb), CBC: top middle. g/dL (US) or g/L (SI), e.g. "13.2". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

inr.description: INR, coags: below the line. e.g. "1.1". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

k.description: Potassium (K), BMP: bottom left. mmol/L, e.g. "4.1". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

mg.description: Magnesium (Mg), Ca/Mg/Phos: bottom left. mg/dL (US) or mmol/L (SI), e.g. "2.0". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

na.description: Sodium (Na), BMP: top left. mmol/L, e.g. "138". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

pco2.description: pCO2, ABG: second. mmHg (US) or kPa (SI), e.g. "40". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

ph.description: pH, ABG: first. e.g. "7.38". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

phos.description: Phosphate (Phos), Ca/Mg/Phos: bottom right. mg/dL (US) or mmol/L (SI), e.g. "3.4". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

plt.description: Platelets (Plt), CBC: right. ×10³/µL, e.g. "245". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

po2.description: pO2, ABG: third. mmHg (US) or kPa (SI), e.g. "92". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

pt.description: Prothrombin time (PT), coags: top left. Seconds, e.g. "12.8". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

ptt.description: Partial thromboplastin time (PTT/aPTT), coags: top right. Seconds, e.g. "31". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

tbili.description: Total bilirubin (T bili), LFT: top right. mg/dL (US) or µmol/L (SI), e.g. "0.8". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

tp.description: Total protein (TP), LFT: top left. g/dL (US) or g/L (SI), e.g. "7.0". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

type.description: Which skeleton to draw, and which value keys it reads: "bmp" (basic metabolic panel / Chem-7: na, cl, bun over k, hco3, cr, with glu in the tail), "cbc" (wbc > hgb over hct < plt), "coag" (pt | ptt over inr), "lft" (hepatic panel: tp, ast, tbili over alb, alt, alp), "abg" (ph / pco2 / po2 / hco3) or "chem" (extended electrolytes: ca over mg | phos). Default "bmp". Keys that belong to another type are ignored with a warning.

wbc.description: White blood cells (WBC), CBC: left. ×10³/µL, e.g. "8.4". A string of up to 8 characters; non-numeric text such as "<0.1", "pending" or "—" is shown as written and never flagged. Omit it to leave the position blank.

title.description: Heading shown top-left at 22px bold, e.g. "Day 3 labs". An empty string hides it. Never put a patient name or identifier here: links carry the chart itself.

units.description: Which reference ranges the automatic flags use: "US" (conventional units: mg/dL, g/dL, %, mmHg; the default) or "SI" (mmol/L, µmol/L, g/L, L/L, kPa). It does not convert values.

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400). Omit it (recommended) and the chart sizes itself to its content with comfortable margins, between 880 and 1280px wide. PNG output renders at 2x.
